name: NOAA Coral Reef Watch 5km Satellite Coral Bleaching Heat Stress
description: NOAA Coral Reef Watch (CRW) Version 3.1 provides daily, global 5-kilometer (0.05°) satellite-derived products monitoring thermal stress on coral reef ecosystems from 1985 to the present. Using blended sea surface temperature (SST) analyses from polar-orbiting and geostationary environmental satellites, CRW computes daily SST anomalies, Coral Bleaching HotSpots, and Degree Heating Weeks (DHW) — the metric measuring accumulated thermal stress linked to mass coral bleaching and mortality events worldwide.
